This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Shadow Rift by paying {U}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems each trigger.
Resolve the first Percursor Golem trigger, creating a copy of Shadow Rift targeting every other Golem.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the first Shadow Rift, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 10 until you draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game.
